claims.A3: Every published aminx release on PyPI is an alpha or other pre-release version.
claims.A46: PyPI project names aminx-hub and praxia-science are unregistered (the JSON API returns 404).
claims.A47: No public GitHub repository exists at maraxen/aminx-hub or maraxen/praxia-science (HTTP 404; a private repository would also return 404, so this proves only that no public repo exists).

prereg.question: Are the two hub name candidates (aminx-hub, and a praxia.science-derived praxia-science) free on PyPI and as public GitHub repos, and is every existing aminx release a pre-release (which bounds who a release-train mistake can surprise)?
prereg.expect_if_true: pypi aminx status=200 with all_prerelease=True; pypi aminx-hub and pypi praxia-science status=404; github maraxen/aminx-hub and maraxen/praxia-science status=404 (and maraxen/aminx status=200 as the positive control that github lookups work).
prereg.expect_if_false: Any candidate name returns 200 (taken: the S3-01 recommendation moves to the next candidate), or aminx lists a stable release (all_prerelease=False), or the positive control maraxen/aminx is not 200 (probe invalid). Any ERR status means transport failure: inconclusive, re-run under a new id.
